name: BMW Siemens MS43 (M54) — ms4x-net 430069
notes: BMW petrol DME, Siemens MS43 (Siemens C167-family 16-bit MCU), as fitted to M54 / M52TU / S54-adjacent inline-6 (E39/E46/E53/Z3/Z4). Map and identity definitions imported from the GPL-3 ms4x-net project (see docs/BMW-MS4X-IMPORT.md); only the DEFINITIONS were taken — no ROM/firmware binaries. Addresses are for software 430069 indexed in the FULL 512 KiB image (calibration region based at 0x70000); the 64 KiB calibration read uses base 0x0 (do NOT mix the two bases). flash_size, regions and all map addresses are valid for this exact software at this base — confirm per software variant before any read or write. protocol/diag_layer/bitrate/tx_id/rx_id are PLACEHOLDERS (confirm per unit): BMW MS4x diagnose over K-line (BMW DS2 / KWP2000); a complete original (full read) and any write need a bench/boot (BDM) tool — stock MS4x is not OBD-flashable. Checksum support is intentionally out of scope here (checksum=null).
